Definition: apparently a primary word; conquest (abstractly), i.e. (figuratively) the means of success:--victory.
BiblicalUsage: Victory is the thing itself, and John says what it is: the victory that overcomes the world is our faith. Whatever is born of God overcomes the world, and faith is the means of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe faith is the victory — not my strength, not my numbers, but the trust that lays hold of what God has already won.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
